
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
data <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
gt(head(data))
ggplot(data,aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
    geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Temp (C)") +
  ggtitle("Temperature by Date")
```
```{r}
ukhsa <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(ukhsa))
ggplot(ukhsa,aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
    geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Cases") +
  ggtitle("Cases by Date")
```
